attribution: NC source/R05 body and retained skull/ears/neck: Scan-the-World Sainsbury Amida, Zenodo21353739, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21353739 , CC BY-NC-SA4.0. Actual facial surface target: Buddha head by peel-3d.com, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/buddha-head-fb17c123ad9c4c0fb6baf723b3fffd79 , CC BY4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Donor culture/period unspecified; not claimed Japanese. Modifications: real3D BVH ray-triangle surface retarget onto NC connected topology, 99% core donor hit plus1% source regularization, broad smooth neck/temple/scalp transition; knownR05 curl relief removed and bounded source cap cage. Originals retained unchanged. No endorsement implied. Combined adaptation/imagery retains NC-SA4.0; original donor remains CC BY4.0. R06f additionally fairs a measured 3D source scalp radial field, with compact anisotropic deformation of existing scalp and restrained Taubin fairing of actual head triangles; no synthetic head replacement. R06g fairs the actual inherited scalp ridge with 300 pinned-boundary Laplacian steps and reduces lower-cheek scan chatter with 60 Taubin pairs. R06h carves fine shallow spiral curl relief directly into the same continuous scalp; sampled original scalp vertex roots and tangent frames retained. R06j, after rejecting I for excessive ear/jaw smoothing, repositions the anterior ear attachment posteriorly and inward, preserves the ear bowl/rim through smooth anchors, and blends side-cheek/jaw curvature with gentler connected-mesh fairing. Actual donor eyelid/nose/lip cores and all body positions below Y2.15 remain exact. Ear attachment is a declared reshaped derivative.

retarget.method: Actual3D BVH/Moller-Trumbore ray intersection from outside toward measured skull center; outermost actual donor triangle hit in XYZ. Not an image/depth/height projection. Broad angular and vertical transition on the existing connected NC surface; no inserted disc or hidden closed head.

bodyPreservation.scope: All R05 positions below Y2.15 remain exact.

trace.format: 24bytes: uint32 NC/R05 vertex, uint32 donor component triangle, float32 barycentric3, float32 actual surface blend weight. Full donor XYZ transform supplied above.

displacement.format: 20-byte RD06 header: ASCII RD06, uint32 vertexCount, uint32 version1, reserved8; then float32 XYZ deltas from R05, same vertex/index topology.

limits: Purposeful donor anatomy study, not accepted photographic likeness.
Ray-sampled donor surface can lose very small undercuts; actual lid/lip shape must be judged from front/true3q/profile.
Source topology/finite normals do not prove self-intersection freedom.
No canonical/shared/Git edits, Blender, export, Blend or movie.
Topological connectivity is not visual C1 continuity; root-requested true profile and 3q must be inspected before front/full review.

sourceCrown.angularBlend: front elevation .30 to .80 rad; rear elevation .01 to .53 rad, cosine-interpolated azimuth bounds

field.format: float64 little-endian radial lengths; 96 elevation rows x 128 periodic azimuth columns

sourceCrown.method: Measured pre-curl NC scalp radii sampled in 3D, spherical Gaussian fairing, compact deformation of existing scalp vertices by smooth angular weights; no ellipsoid or independent replacement head.

headFairing.method: 18 Taubin pairs lambda .45, mu -.47 on actual connected mesh; smooth pinned neck boundary; preserves actual donor anatomy at larger scales

predecessor.rootRejectedFor: Vertical cheek-ear ridge/gutter and abrupt chin-neck join

scalp.mask: Azimuth-interpolated boundary: front Y2.70..2.785, rear Y2.57..2.655

cheeks.scope: Lower side cheeks only; excludes core nose, lips, eyelids and ears

compactCurls.method: Smooth summed shallow curl relief and one-turn cut spiral in actual continuous scalp coordinates; no added geometry, beads or tube meshes.
compactCurls.hairline: Front Y2.78, side Y2.715, rear Y2.60; 0.016-unit continuous feather

rootTrace.format: 56-byte records: uint32 source G vertex; float32 position3, normal3, tangentU3, radius, height, phase, reserved4. TangentV = normal cross tangentU.

sideJawEarFairing.method: Posterior/inward bounded warp of the existing anterior ear attachment, followed by gentle symmetric implicit graph fairing. Source ear bowl/rim has smooth positional anchors. Only actual eye/nose/lip feature cores are pinned; side cheeks and jaw remain free across broad smooth transition weights. No added surface or material concealment.
sideJawEarFairing.coreDefinition: Smooth ellipsoidal protection around actual H eye cores (X +/-0.137,Y2.585), nose (Y2.53) and lips (Y2.345), with exact position constraints only at feature centers.
